title: Four walks cannot find the Shadow entry in the Effects list
goal: Four scripted runs stop because they cannot reach the tick, or the colour, on the Shadow entry of the Effects list: the app answers that no such thing is there. Until that is sorted nobody can prove by machine that turning an effect off and on, or dropping a colour on one, still works.
acceptance: Whatever the cause turns out to be, no walk step was weakened or deleted to make it pass
